gaps: Dogfood risk: would the new spec-coverage gap red the harness repo itself the moment it merges?
False-alarm risk: a fresh forge init scaffold has no roadmap - would no-roadmap fire on every new project?
Duplicate-computation risk: unreferenced-specs is computed in record_signoff, board._summary, and now project_gaps - three drifting copies?
Severity ambiguity: should doctor also hard-fail on the missing roadmap, duplicating audit's exit-1?
Double-reporting: with an empty roadmap, would every confirmed spec also fire spec-coverage on top of no-roadmap?
resolutions: Pre-verified read-only in planning: every confirmed spec is referenced (empty diff), 3 epics / 24 items - harness audits clean; a live dogfood audit is in the verify plan.

The discovery-material predicate (harvested ledger entries, decision records, confirmed specs - the spec's own definition) gates no-roadmap; a fresh scaffold has none, pinned by test_project_audit_clean_on_fresh_scaffold.
Factored to specs.unreferenced_confirmed_specs(); record_signoff swaps to it byte-identically; board's copy stays display-only by stated choice (churn outside this story's criteria).
Doctor stays advisory-tier per its role (what you run when things are already broken); the exit-1 teeth live in project audit and sanitise --check, per the spec's severity split.
spec-coverage is gated on the roadmap having items; the empty case reports exactly one no-roadmap gap.
notes: Interrogated against FORGE-ALIGN-2 acceptance criteria, docs/specs/strict-alignment.md, and the 31 active decisions. No user-decision frontier remained; human approved the plan in plan mode (0029 flow). No new decision records - semantics are written in the confirmed spec.
